units.october-forecast-model:
Units: floats per lane-op (one lane, one micro-op slot; a TensorFMA op is 4,096 lane-ops); int8 per integer slot-op (4 int8
MACs; 512 slot-ops per lane per op). Card voltages: aifoundry3 (a3) 0.522 V, card 1 (c1) 0.499 V. Energy is heat (half CV²
per transition plus internal energy). Electrons count the charge drawn from the supply. Power is the model's energy above
the zeros anchor times the lab's measured op rate at 600 MHz. "Data flips" is the part that follows the operands (for int8 it
still includes the integer unit's clock, see above). The band is kind-to-kind: an assumed per-set-operand-bit term (0 to 0.32 fJ
per set bit, from the lab's int8 residual) plus a third of the shared-bus wire term. The level band is separate: on the
committed ones kinds the model reads 0.97-0.98x the measured D on aifoundry3 and 0.93x on card 1 (fp32 and fp16 alike), and
0.99x / 0.93x for int8 ones.
units.october-forecast-model int8 v2:
Per integer slot-op (4 int8 MACs). "Data flips" now excludes the integer unit's clock, which is given beside them. Power here
is at the die (the model's energy above zeros times the op rate), not at the board: the board adds roughly a quarter on these
cards. The band is the held-operand term (0 up to the lab's measured ones-against-neg_ones residual per set operand bit).

per_pair_as_written.october-forecast-model: Per pair, from the same forecast (aifoundry3 / card 1): fp32 5s - 4s +0.0128 / +0.0116 W; fp16 +0.0114 / +0.0103 W; int8 +0.039 / +0.036 W (v1, see the weakness above; E178 registered +0.186 W).
per_pair_as_written.october-forecast-model int8 v2: int8 v2, 5s - 4s: +4.97 fJ per slot-op above zeros on aifoundry3 (+4.53 on card 1); D +0.039 W at the die (band +0.039 to +0.050), about +0.047 W board-equivalent, against E178's registered +0.186 W at the board. Data flips alone are 1.66x; the clock's held-state term is -2.3 fJ.
